title: Hiring: Remote Appointment Setters — Philippines
description:
U.S. Gold & Silver Company | Paid Training | Base Pay + Performance Incentives

Parkview Capital Group, based in Scottsdale, Arizona, is hiring two Philippines-based appointment setters to speak with U.S. prospects interested in gold and silver.

We’re looking for confident communicators who are comfortable making outbound calls, following a script, and keeping a positive attitude when prospects say no.

Your Role

• Call company-provided leads using our predictive dialer.

• Follow a short script to introduce our company and qualify interested prospects.

• Connect qualified prospects with our experienced U.S. sales team.

• Record accurate notes and call outcomes in our CRM.

Our closers handle the sales process. Your focus is starting conversations and identifying interested prospects.

Who We’re Looking For

• Clear spoken English and strong listening skills.

• A professional, friendly phone manner.

• Reliability, coachability, and comfort receiving feedback.

• Ability to work the U.S. schedule listed below.

• A quiet workspace, reliable internet, a computer, and a quality headset.

• BPO, outbound calling, telemarketing, or appointment-setting experience is preferred. Strong communicators without experience are welcome to apply.

Pay & Schedule

• Base pay: $4/Hour

• Incentives: 1% on ALL SALES + Bonus Structure of Qualified Leads

• Schedule: 8 AM – 5 PM PST (1 Hour Lunch)

• Location: Remote — Philippines

• Paid training and ongoing coaching.

• Company-provided leads, dialer, CRM, and script.



How to Apply

 
 with the subject line:

Philippines Appointment Setter – [Your Name]

Please include:

1. Your resume.

2. A 30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining any relevant calling or customer-service experience.

3. Confirmation that you can work the listed schedule.

4. Your earliest available start date.

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview and a brief mock call.

title: Accounting Oversight / QuickBooks Bookkeeping Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced QuickBooks bookkeeping professional to help oversee our company books, identify and correct accounting errors, and establish accurate monthly financial reporting.

The ideal candidate understands how the books flow, from invoices, payments, bills, expenses, bank transactions, and credit card activity through the General Ledger and ultimately into the Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet.



Responsibilities include:

 • Oversee bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Desktop

 • Review and clean up existing books

 • Identify incorrect, duplicate, missing, or miscategorized transactions

 • Reconcile bank and credit card accounts

 • Review Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable

 • Review and clean up the Chart of Accounts

 • Review General Ledger activity and unusual balances

 • Prepare accurate monthly P&L and Balance Sheet reports

 • Help establish a consistent month-end close process

 • Identify discrepancies and clearly explain corrections

 • Work with Abigail and the billing/operations team to improve accounting controls

 • Coordinate with the company CPA when necessary

Qualifications:

 • Strong QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Desktop experience

 • Strong bookkeeping and General Ledger knowledge

 • Proven experience cleaning up company books

 • Experience with reconciliations, A/R, A/P, P&L, and Balance Sheet reporting

 • Ability to troubleshoot accounting discrepancies

 • QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification preferred

 • Landscaping, construction, service, or field-service accounting experience is a plus



We need someone who can oversee the books and understand the full accounting picture, not simply enter transactions.

title: HEAD AI VIDEO EDITOR AND STRATEGIST
description:
WHO WE ARE

Spark Marketing Agency is a fast-growing digital marketing firm dedicated to scaling home service contractors across the US. We utilize data-driven advertising, local SEO, and in-house media production to build predictable revenue engines for our clients. Our commitment to operational excellence and real ROI over vanity metrics has allowed us to deliver measurable growth and keep our clients winning month after month. We are focused on turning ad spend into signed contracts while building a team of highly accountable, top-tier professionals.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Head Editor with deep experience in both long-form and short-form content. You will manage a team of other editors while spearheading the creative strategy for our ad campaigns. You are the bridge between high-level creative vision and practical AI implementation. You will not only produce top-tier video content but also train your team to leverage the latest generative AI tools to increase output quality and speed across the entire department.



RESPONSIBILITIES

* Manage and mentor a team of video editors, ensuring strict quality standards across all deliverables.

* Develop and oversee the creative strategy for client video ad campaigns.

* Edit high-level, complex projects spanning both long and short-form formats.

* Standardize AI integration workflows for the editing team to accelerate production.

* Review team edits, provide actionable feedback, and approve final exports before client delivery.

* Continuously test and implement emerging AI video advancements to keep the agency ahead of industry trends.



REQUIREMENTS

* Significant prior experience managing a team of video editors or creatives.

* Proven expertise in editing both long-form and short-form content for direct-response marketing.

* Deep, practical knowledge of generative AI tools for video, audio, and visual asset creation.

* Strong background in creative strategy and ad performance analysis.

* Clear communication skills with the ability to deliver candid feedback and lead a remote team.

* High-level graphic design skills to guide the creation of static flyers and visual assets.



LOGISTICS

* Fully remote position

* Immediate start preferred

* Competitive compensation based on experience

* Hiring Process Phase 1: Portfolio and strategy review evaluating your past management roles, strategic campaign success, and AI workflows.

* Hiring Process Phase 2: Candidates who pass the portfolio review will have a strategic interview with company leadership to discuss team management and creative vision.

* Hiring Process Phase 3: Final offer, where compensation will be discussed and determined based on experience, followed by onboarding.

title: Operations and Reporting Coordinator
description:
Operations and Reporting Coordinator

Full-time, remote. Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm US Central (10:00pm to 7:00am Manila time from November to March; 9:00pm to 6:00am from March to November). Reports to Operations Lead.



ABOUT LUX & NYX

Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. Featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. We sell across Shopify DTC, Amazon, Nordstrom, and Macy's, and through a corporate gifting channel. Remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu.



THE ROLE

You'll keep the back end of our business right: the numbers we d
 on, the products we list, and every order after the customer clicks Buy. You'll prepare our daily sales and ads reports, be our warehouse's main contact, answer our customers, and keep our listings and catalogs accurate on every channel. You'll work closely with Michelle, who leads operations, and take vendor follow-up and day-to-day execution off her plate.



This role is half care and half precision. You need to be warm with a customer and politely persistent with a vendor, and you need to refuse to upload, send or pay anything when a number doesn't match its source. The most valuable thing you do is catch the mistake before it goes live.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Reporting: prepare our daily sales report and marketing ads reports, check every number against its source, and flag anything that doesn't add up.

• Orders and the warehouse: keep orders moving across our store, Amazon and retail partners, be our warehouse's main contact, check the returns, files and invoices it sends us, and follow up with vendors until every issue is closed.

• Customer care and reviews: answer customers within one business day, warmly and in our brand voice, including refunds, returns and warranty claims, and look after our product reviews.

• Inventory and listings: keep stock files, product listings, our ESP and SAGE corporate gifting catalogs and approved promotions accurate on every channel, checked against our master sheet.

• Production support: get our weekly production meeting ready, and prepare purchase orders, packing lists and shipping documents from approved inputs.

• Returns and tickets: reconcile returns and refunds, and follow every open support ticket until it's fixed.

• Systems and SOPs: write down every step you own, keep our trackers current, help set up new sales channels, and run the automations we approve.



Not part of this role: pricing, budget and other financial decisions, paid ads management, forecasting, corporate gifting quotes and orders (another teammate owns those), running the warehouse floor, product design, and accounting.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• You stop rather than upload. If a count, price or SKU doesn't match its source, nothing goes live until it does. That's the number one thing.

• You can trace every number. Ask where a figure came from and you can show the source. You're comfortable with totals, per-unit costs and variances.

• You work it out yourself. AI can help you draft or double-check, but the thinking and the judgment are yours.

• 2+ years reconciling or reporting operational data: inventory, orders and invoices, e-commerce reporting, or marketplace operations.

• Hands-on e-commerce listing experience: Amazon flat files, retailer portals or Shopify product setup, including fixing rejected or suppressed listings.

• Customer care for an online brand: order questions, refunds, returns and warranty claims, written warmly and clearly.

• Strong spreadsheet skills: formulas, lookups and reconciliations.

• Clear, polished written English, and steady follow-through without anyone having to chase you.

• A builder: when something was never written down, you write it down and make it the standard.

• Here for the long haul: you want to own this work and get great at it.



A strong plus: Mirakl, ShipStation, ESP or SAGE catalogs, retailer vendor portals, EDI, packing lists and carton planning, or working day to day with a warehouse.



You don't need every box ticked. If you catch the mistake before it goes live and you can show where every number came from, we want to hear from you.



WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

• Every report goes out on time and matches its source.

• Customers hear back within one business day.

• Every listing and catalog matches our master sheet.

• Every open vendor issue and support ticket has a next step.

• Every recurring step is written down.



PAY AND BENEFITS

US$600 to $1,300 a month depending on experience, plus a performance bonus. Paid PTO. Health stipend. Weekly 1:1 with Michelle, async-first on Slack.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply right here on OnlineJobs.ph. Your application must do three things:



1. Start with the word TRACE.

2. Answer this in your own words: It's Monday, December 21. Tomorrow at 10:00am US Central you upload the Amazon available-to-sell file. Last Friday's inventory file shows 448 units of the Belt Bag in Black. On Saturday, 30 units shipped on a corporate order. Today's warehouse count shows 412 units. 12 customer returns arrived Friday and haven't been inspected yet. The warehouse is closed Thursday and Friday for Christmas. What number would you upload, what do you check before you do, who do you tell, and by when?

3. Include your resume, or a Google Drive link to it that opens.



Applications missing any of the three won't be reviewed. Those three steps are deliberate: they show us, before we ever meet, whether you read carefully and own the details.



NEXT STEPS

If you're shortlisted: a short form and a recorded video intro, then a paid skills test, then a call with our founder where you'll walk us through some of your answers. Then an offer.

title: B2B Order & Fulfillment Coordinator
description:
B2B Order & Fulfillment Coordinator

Full-time, remote. Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm US Central (10:00pm to 7:00am Manila time from November to March; 9:00pm to 6:00am from March to November). Reports to Lisa Hu, Founder & CEO.



IF YOU PLAN BACKWARD FROM THE DEADLINE, READ ON

A business customer needs 300 custom bags delivered for an event on a fixed date. Artwork, decoration, kitting, cartons, labels and shipping all have to line up, across people who don't work for us. Most people start at the beginning and hope it lands in time. We're looking for the person who starts at the in-hand date, works backward, and tells everyone exactly when their piece is due.



ABOUT LUX & NYX

Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. Featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. We sell on our own site, Amazon, Nordstrom and Macy's, and through a corporate gifting business served by promotional-products distributors. Remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu.



THE ROLE

You'll own our B2B orders from the first inquiry to the day they arrive. Nearly every inquiry comes from a distributor pitching our bags to their client. You answer the same day, send accurate quotes, follow every open quote until it's a yes or a no, and when it's a yes, you plan the order backward from its in-hand date and line up every party in time. Inside the team, you keep things moving: you run our internal meetings, follow up on every action item, and help Lisa turn recurring work into systems.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Inquiries and quotes: pricing, minimums, colorways, decoration options and lead times, checked against stock and the calendar before you commit to a date.

• Open quotes: every one tracked with a next step and the client's event date, followed up because a deadline is coming, not just because time has passed.

• Order entry and confirmation: re-check stock, pricing and timing before you confirm, and make sure the PO, the quote and the confirmation match.

• Backward planning: for every dated order, the date art must be approved, when the designer and decorator start, and when the warehouse kits and ships, with each party briefed in time.

• Pack-out and shipping: cartons and labels from our pack-out spec (a partial carton is still a carton), counts confirmed with the warehouse, and a final check before anything ships. If a number isn't on file, you go get it. You never estimate it.

• Team coordination: run our internal meetings with a clear agenda, notes and action items, then follow up with each owner until every item is closed.

• Systems for the founder: when Lisa asks, help her turn a recurring admin task into a system (an SOP, a template or an AI workflow) so it runs without her. You build the system; AI and the system do the admin.

• Backup for our operations teammate: cover listings, catalog updates and customer care when they're out on holiday or leave.

• SOPs: write down every step you own, so nothing lives in one person's head.



Not part of this role: cold outbound prospecting (our founder and sales consultant own that), managing people, doing Lisa's day-to-day admin (AI covers most of it), and day-to-day listings and customer care (our operations coordinator owns those; you cover when they're out).



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• You stop rather than send. If a price, date or count doesn't add up, nothing goes out until it does. That's the number one thing.

• You plan backward from the deadline. Give you an in-hand date and you can tell us the date every step has to start, and who needs to hear about it first.

• 3+ years in B2B order management: wholesale, corporate gifting, promotional products or similar, with orders that run for weeks across several outside parties (vendors, decorators, warehouses, carriers).

• Clear, polished English, written and spoken. You can hold a buyer conversation on your own, quote with confidence, and say "here's what it takes" instead of an easy yes.

• Organized follow-through: dozens of open quotes and action items at once, each with a next step, none forgotten.

• A builder: when something was never written down, you write it down and make it the standard, and you'd rather build a system than do the same task twice.

• Comfortable with the tools: spreadsheets with formulas, a CRM or pipeline tracker, and AI for drafting and simple workflows, with the judgment staying yours.

• Here for the long haul: you want to own this work and get great at it.



A plus: listing, catalog or customer care work on ESP, SAGE, Amazon, Shopify or retailer portals, since you'll cover for our operations teammate. We'll train you on our process.



You don't need every box ticked. If you've planned a dated order backward and caught the number that didn't add up before it shipped, we want to hear from you.



WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

• Every inquiry answered the same business day.

• Zero quotes sent with a wrong price, minimum or lead time.

• Every open quote has a next step, and none goes quiet without a decision.

• Every order lands by its in-hand date, with cartons, labels and packing list matching.

• Every meeting ends with owners and dates, and every action item closes.

• Every system you build keeps running without you or Lisa babysitting it.



PAY AND BENEFITS

US$900 to $1,300 a month depending on experience, plus a performance bonus. Paid PTO. Health stipend. Weekly 1:1 with Lisa, async-first on Slack.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply right here on OnlineJobs.ph. Your application must do three things:



1. Start with the word CLEAN.

2. In three sentences, tell us about an order with a hard deadline that you planned backward from: what had to happen when, and who you had to line up.

3. Include your resume, or a Google Drive link to it that opens.



Applications missing any of the three won't be reviewed. Those steps are deliberate: they show us, before we ever meet, whether you read carefully and own the details.



NEXT STEPS

If you're shortlisted: a recorded video intro (3 to 5 minutes), then a paid skills test based on real work ($20, about 4 hours), then an interview with our founder and a reference check.

- Obtain detailed dental benefits, including deductibles, annual maximums, coverage percentages, waiting periods, and frequency limitations.

- Verify specific CDT procedure codes and coverage restrictions.

- Confirm treating providers' In-Network (INN) or Out-of-Network (OON) status.

- Contact insurance companies through phone calls and online portals to obtain benefit breakdowns.

- Accurately document and update insurance information in the verification system.

- Identify discrepancies, missing information, and potential coverage limitations.

- Meet daily productivity targets and required turnaround times.

- Maintain high accuracy and comply with HIPAA regulations.

- Communicate with Team Leaders regarding pending cases and escalations.



**Qualifications:**

- Previous dental insurance verification experience preferred.

- Knowledge of dental terminology, CDT codes, and insurance benefits.

- Familiarity with dental insurance portals and practice management systems is an advantage.

- Good English communication skills, both written and verbal.

- Strong attention to detail and time management skills.

- Ability to work independently and meet daily quotas.

- Willingness to learn new systems and AI-assisted verification tools.



**Work Requirements:**

- Reliable internet connection and working computer.

- Ability to work on a US-based schedule.

- Consistent attendance and commitment to productivity and accuracy.

title: Cold call and sales Coach 1 on 1
description:
I am looking for an experienced **Sales Coach / Sales Trainer / Cold Calling Trainer** to work with me one-on-one.



I am **not looking for someone to make cold calls for me**. I am looking for someone who will **personally train and coach me so I become much better at cold calling and selling.**



The right person should be comfortable actively coaching me, challenging me, correcting me, and doing realistic role-plays with me.



## What I Want to Learn



I want to become confident and effective on the phone, including:



* How to start a cold call confidently

* How to create and deliver a strong pitch

* What exactly to say and how to say it

* How to sound confident, natural, and conversational

* How to avoid sounding nervous, robotic, or overly scripted

* How to ask good questions

* How to keep the prospect engaged

* How to identify the prospect's needs

* How to transition naturally into the offer

* How to ask for the appointment or sale

* How to handle rejection

* How to handle difficult prospects

* How to overcome common objections

* How to think on my feet when the prospect says something unexpected

* How to become more comfortable and confident through repeated practice



## I Want REAL Role-Playing



This is extremely important.



I want you to actually **play the role of the prospect** while I practice calling you.



For example, you might act like a prospect who says:



> "I'm not interested."



Then I respond.



You challenge me again.



You might say:



> "Just send me an
."



Or:



> "We already have someone."



Or:



> "How much does it cost?"



Or:



> "Where did you get my number?"



Or give me another realistic objection.



I want you to **challenge me instead of making the role-play easy.**



After the role-play, I want you to explain:



* What I did well

* What I did poorly

* Where I sounded uncertain

* What I should have said instead

* How I could improve my wording

* How I could sound more confident

* Where I talked too much

* Where I should have asked a question

* Where I should have pushed back

* How I could have moved the conversation toward an appointment or sale



Then I want to **do the role-play again** and apply your corrections.



## I Want a Coach Who Will Push Me



Please don't simply tell me that everything sounds good.



I want someone who will respectfully **challenge me and point out my weaknesses**.



If my pitch is weak, tell me.



If I sound nervous, tell me.



If I'm talking too much, stop me.



If I'm asking the wrong question, explain what I should ask.



If I'm avoiding asking for the sale, challenge me to actually ask.



The goal is for me to improve through **repetition, feedback, and realistic practice.**



## Help Me Build My Pitch



I would also like help developing and improving my actual sales pitch.



You should be able to help me:



1. Understand the product/service I'm selling

2. Create a strong opening

3. Develop the pitch

4. Create good discovery questions

5. Prepare responses to common objections

6. Practice the entire conversation

7. Adjust the script so it sounds natural rather than memorized

8. Practice until I can deliver it confidently



## Experience I'm Looking For



You should have significant experience in one or more of the following:



* Cold calling

* B2B sales

* B2C sales

* Sales training

* Sales coaching

* Sales management

* SDR/BDR training

* Business development

* Appointment setting

* Closing

* Objection handling

* Phone sales

* Sales role-playing

* Sales performance coaching



**Teaching/coaching ability is very important.**



Being a good salesperson alone is not enough. You need to be able to **teach another person how to sell.**



## Sample Video — VERY IMPORTANT



If you have a video showing yourself doing any of the following, please send it with your application:



* Sales coaching

* Cold-call training

* Role-playing a sales call

* Teaching someone how to sell

* Demonstrating a cold call

* Handling objections

* Training salespeople



It does **not** have to be a professionally produced video.



I mainly want to see **how you actually teach and coach.**



If you don't have an existing video, you may record a short sample explaining how you would coach someone through a cold call.



## Please Include Your Desired Rate



Please tell me **how much you are asking per hour** for this type of one-on-one coaching.



Do not simply write "negotiable."



Please provide your actual requested hourly rate.



## Please Answer These Questions



1. How many years of sales experience do you have?

2. How many years of sales training/coaching experience do you have?

3. Have you personally trained people to cold call?

4. Have you done live sales role-play with students or salespeople?

5. What types of products/services have you sold?

6. What type of sales were you involved in — B2B, B2C, high-ticket, appointment setting, closing, etc.?

7. How do you normally structure a one-on-one sales coaching session?

8. How do you teach someone to sound more confident on the phone?

9. How do you teach objection handling?

10. Are you comfortable challenging the student rather than simply giving encouragement?

11. Do you have a sample video? **Please provide the link.**

12. What is your desired hourly rate?



## Top 3 Skills



Please make sure your profile/application highlights these three skills:



**1. Cold Calling & Sales Training**



**2. Sales Role-Play & Objection Handling**



**3. Sales Pitch, Confidence & Communication Coaching**



I am looking for someone interested in **ongoing one-on-one coaching**, not just a one-time session.



Please apply with your experience, sample video if available, and desired hourly rate.

title: # Professional Voice Training Specialist / Vocal Coach — One-on-One Remote Training
description:
**Remote | One-on-One Training | Professional Voice Development**



I am looking for an **experienced professional voice training specialist / vocal coach** to work with me one-on-one remotely.



My goal is to improve my voice as much as realistically possible — including making it **clearer, stronger, more pleasant, better controlled, more confident, and more professional-sounding.**



This is **NOT simply a singing teacher position.**



I am specifically looking for someone who understands the **voice itself** and can professionally assess and train an individual's voice.



## WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR



You should have strong professional knowledge and experience in areas such as:



- Vocal training and voice development

- **Vocal and throat anatomy**

- Breathing and breath support

- Vocal production

- Resonance

- Projection

- Pitch and pitch control

- Tone and vocal quality

- Articulation and clarity

- Vocal placement

- Voice strength and control

- Proper vocal technique

- Identifying weaknesses in a person's voice

- Creating exercises specifically for an individual's needs



You should be able to **listen carefully to my voice, identify what can be improved, explain what is happening, and create a structured training program to work on it.**



I am looking for someone who can determine **what is actually limiting the quality of my voice** and then develop exercises and techniques specifically for those areas.



## REMOTE ONE-ON-ONE TRAINING



Training will be conducted remotely through live video sessions.



You should be comfortable:



- Demonstrating exercises through video

- Listening carefully to my voice

- Watching my technique

- Correcting me in real time

- Explaining exactly what I am doing incorrectly

- Demonstrating the correct technique

- Having me repeat an exercise until I understand it

- Giving me exercises to practice between sessions

- Tracking my progress from session to session



I am looking for a **personalized training program**, not a generic lesson plan.



If there are certain things that genuinely require an in-person professional, I can arrange that separately locally. The primary training will be done remotely.



## IMPORTANT — REMOTE AUDIO QUALITY & VOICE ASSESSMENT



Because this is voice training, **being able to accurately hear my voice is extremely important.**



I am not looking for someone who simply knows how to conduct a Zoom call.



You should understand the limitations of remote voice training and know how to get the **clearest and most accurate representation of the voice possible through technology.**



You should be able to recommend the best setup for our sessions, including:



- Which platform you recommend for voice training — **Zoom, Google Meet,
, or another platform — and why**

- What type of microphone you recommend

- Whether I should use headphones or a headset

- How I should position myself in relation to the microphone

- What audio settings you recommend

- Whether any platform features such as **noise suppression, echo cancellation, automatic gain control, compression, or other audio processing** could interfere with accurately evaluating the voice

- Whether any settings should be changed or disabled during voice training

- Whether you recommend live sessions alone or also using **high-quality voice recordings**

- What type of recordings you would want me to provide before our first session

- How you distinguish actual characteristics of my voice from artifacts caused by the microphone, room, software, or internet connection



### I want you to be able to hear my actual voice.



If you believe another platform or setup would allow you to evaluate the voice more accurately than standard Zoom settings, **tell me what you recommend and why.**



You should have a thoughtful answer to this rather than simply saying, "Zoom is fine."



## VIDEO TEACHING EXPERIENCE



I am particularly interested in seeing **how you actually teach**, not just hearing about your qualifications.



If available, please provide a **short video of yourself actually teaching or coaching someone's voice.**



I would especially like to see how you:



- Listen to a student's voice

- Identify a problem

- Explain what you hear

- Demonstrate an exercise

- Correct the student

- Give feedback

- Adjust your approach based on the individual student



A singing performance or promotional video is **not as useful to me** as a video showing you actually teaching.



If you do not have a teaching video available, please explain your previous experience conducting one-on-one voice training.



## WHAT I EXPECT FROM THE TRAINING



I want the training to be structured and progressive.



I would like you to:



1. Assess my current voice

2. Identify the main areas that need improvement

3. Explain what you are hearing and why it matters

4. Establish specific goals

5. Create exercises for those areas

6. Teach me how to perform the exercises correctly

7. Give me a practice routine between sessions

8. Monitor my progress

9. Adjust the exercises as my voice develops

10. Help me build better control and consistency over time



I am interested in **actual voice development**, not simply being told to "speak with confidence."



## IMPORTANT



I am looking for a **professional**, not someone who simply enjoys singing or has casual experience.



Professional voice coaching, vocal training, singing instruction, speech/voice training, or related professional experience is strongly preferred.



A strong understanding of **vocal/throat anatomy and how the voice physically works** is particularly important.



You should also be able to explain the **reason behind the exercises** you recommend.



If you recommend an exercise, I want to understand what it is intended to change or improve.



## EXPERIENCE



Please tell me:



- How many years you have professionally trained voices

- What type of clients/students you normally work with

- Your professional qualifications or training

- Whether you specialize in singing, speaking voice, vocal development, or multiple areas

- Your experience conducting voice training remotely

- Your experience specifically using video sessions

- Your experience assessing voices through microphones/remote audio

- Any particularly difficult voice-development cases you have successfully worked with

- Whether you have experience creating individualized voice-training programs



## APPLICATION — PLEASE ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS



Please apply through **OnlineJobs.ph**.



In your application, answer all of the following:



**1. Tell me about your professional voice-training experience.**

How many years have you trained voices, and what types of clients have you worked with?



**2. How strong is your knowledge of vocal/throat anatomy?**

Please explain your education, training, or professional experience in this area.



**3. What areas of the voice do you specialize in?**

For example: speaking voice, vocal development, resonance, projection, articulation, tone, breath support, singing, etc.



**4. How would you approach improving someone's voice through remote one-on-one training?**

Please describe what you would actually do during the sessions.



**5. What would you normally assess during the first session?**



**6. Please provide examples of the types of voice problems or weaknesses you have helped people improve.**



**7. How would you set up the technology to accurately hear and evaluate my voice remotely?**

title: # Cold Calling & Sales Role-Play Coach — 1-on-1 Training
description:
I am looking for an experienced **Sales Coach / Sales Trainer / Cold Calling Trainer** to work with me one-on-one.



I am **not looking for someone to make cold calls for me**. I am looking for someone who will **personally train and coach me so I become much better at cold calling and selling.**



The right person should be comfortable actively coaching me, challenging me, correcting me, and doing realistic role-plays with me.



## What I Want to Learn



I want to become confident and effective on the phone, including:



* How to start a cold call confidently

* How to create and deliver a strong pitch

* What exactly to say and how to say it

* How to sound confident, natural, and conversational

* How to avoid sounding nervous, robotic, or overly scripted

* How to ask good questions

* How to keep the prospect engaged

* How to identify the prospect's needs

* How to transition naturally into the offer

* How to ask for the appointment or sale

* How to handle rejection

* How to handle difficult prospects

* How to overcome common objections

* How to think on my feet when the prospect says something unexpected

* How to become more comfortable and confident through repeated practice



## I Want REAL Role-Playing



This is extremely important.



I want you to actually **play the role of the prospect** while I practice calling you.



For example, you might act like a prospect who says:



> "I'm not interested."



Then I respond.



You challenge me again.



You might say:



> "Just send me an
."



Or:



> "We already have someone."



Or:



> "How much does it cost?"



Or:



> "Where did you get my number?"



Or give me another realistic objection.



I want you to **challenge me instead of making the role-play easy.**



After the role-play, I want you to explain:



* What I did well

* What I did poorly

* Where I sounded uncertain

* What I should have said instead

* How I could improve my wording

* How I could sound more confident

* Where I talked too much

* Where I should have asked a question

* Where I should have pushed back

* How I could have moved the conversation toward an appointment or sale



Then I want to **do the role-play again** and apply your corrections.



## I Want a Coach Who Will Push Me



Please don't simply tell me that everything sounds good.



I want someone who will respectfully **challenge me and point out my weaknesses**.



If my pitch is weak, tell me.



If I sound nervous, tell me.



If I'm talking too much, stop me.



If I'm asking the wrong question, explain what I should ask.



If I'm avoiding asking for the sale, challenge me to actually ask.



The goal is for me to improve through **repetition, feedback, and realistic practice.**



## Help Me Build My Pitch



I would also like help developing and improving my actual sales pitch.



You should be able to help me:



1. Understand the product/service I'm selling

2. Create a strong opening

3. Develop the pitch

4. Create good discovery questions

5. Prepare responses to common objections

6. Practice the entire conversation

7. Adjust the script so it sounds natural rather than memorized

8. Practice until I can deliver it confidently



## Experience I'm Looking For



You should have significant experience in one or more of the following:



* Cold calling

* B2B sales

* B2C sales

* Sales training

* Sales coaching

* Sales management

* SDR/BDR training

* Business development

* Appointment setting

* Closing

* Objection handling

* Phone sales

* Sales role-playing

* Sales performance coaching



**Teaching/coaching ability is very important.**



Being a good salesperson alone is not enough. You need to be able to **teach another person how to sell.**



## Sample Video — VERY IMPORTANT



If you have a video showing yourself doing any of the following, please send it with your application:



* Sales coaching

* Cold-call training

* Role-playing a sales call

* Teaching someone how to sell

* Demonstrating a cold call

* Handling objections

* Training salespeople



It does **not** have to be a professionally produced video.



I mainly want to see **how you actually teach and coach.**



If you don't have an existing video, you may record a short sample explaining how you would coach someone through a cold call.



## Please Include Your Desired Rate



Please tell me **how much you are asking per hour** for this type of one-on-one coaching.



Do not simply write "negotiable."



Please provide your actual requested hourly rate.



## Please Answer These Questions



1. How many years of sales experience do you have?

2. How many years of sales training/coaching experience do you have?

3. Have you personally trained people to cold call?

4. Have you done live sales role-play with students or salespeople?

5. What types of products/services have you sold?

6. What type of sales were you involved in — B2B, B2C, high-ticket, appointment setting, closing, etc.?

7. How do you normally structure a one-on-one sales coaching session?

8. How do you teach someone to sound more confident on the phone?

9. How do you teach objection handling?

10. Are you comfortable challenging the student rather than simply giving encouragement?

11. Do you have a sample video? **Please provide the link.**

12. What is your desired hourly rate?



## Top 3 Skills



Please make sure your profile/application highlights these three skills:



**1. Cold Calling & Sales Training**



**2. Sales Role-Play & Objection Handling**



**3. Sales Pitch, Confidence & Communication Coaching**



I am looking for someone interested in **ongoing one-on-one coaching**, not just a one-time session.



Please apply with your experience, sample video if available, and desired hourly rate.

title: # Holistic Mind-Body Practitioner – Subconscious Patterns, Limiting Beliefs & Personal Transformation
description:
**Remote / Zoom | Part-Time / Sessions | Integrative & Experiential Approaches**



I am looking for an experienced holistic wellness, mind-body, or therapeutic practitioner who can help me explore and work on **changing limiting beliefs, transforming old emotional patterns, subconscious conditioning, and personal transformation.**



A major area of interest for me is the methodology and teachings of **Dr. Joe Dispenza**. I am interested in exploring concepts such as breaking old habits of thinking and feeling, changing subconscious patterns, meditation, visualization, emotional conditioning, and developing new mental and emotional states.



**You do NOT need to be an expert in Dr. Joe Dispenza's work or have extensive experience with his specific methodology.** Familiarity with his teachings is a plus, but what matters most is that you have a strong background in related mind-body, psychological, somatic, or experiential approaches.



I am particularly interested in someone who can help me explore different methods of working with limiting beliefs, subconscious patterns, emotions, the nervous system, and the mind-body connection.



I want to learn about different approaches, understand how they work, and, where appropriate, experience them through personalized Zoom sessions.



I am open-minded and interested in exploring multiple methodologies rather than following only one particular school of thought. I value someone who is knowledgeable, curious, experienced, and able to explain and guide different techniques.



## MODALITIES I AM PARTICULARLY INTERESTED IN



You do NOT need to practice every modality below. However, I am especially interested in practitioners who have professional training or substantial experience in several of these areas.



**1. Subconscious Patterns & Belief Change**

- Limiting belief identification and transformation.

- Subconscious reprogramming approaches.

- Hypnotherapy.

- NLP (Neuro-Linguistic Programming).

- Mental rehearsal and visualization.

- Cognitive and emotional pattern change.

- Habit and behavioral reconditioning.



**2. Mind-Body & Emotional Transformation**

- Dr. Joe Dispenza-inspired meditation and mind-body approaches.

- Mind-body connection.

- Emotional processing and release.

- Somatic approaches and body-based work.

- Nervous-system regulation.

- Breathwork.

- Meditation and mindfulness.

- Guided visualization.

- Emotional conditioning and state change.



**3. Internal Patterns & Deeper Psychological Work**

- Internal Family Systems (IFS) / Parts Work.

- Inner-child work.

- Attachment-oriented approaches.

- Trauma-informed approaches.

- Emotional integration.

- Working with unconscious or deeply ingrained patterns.



**4. Other Integrative & Holistic Modalities**

- EFT / Emotional Freedom Techniques (tapping).

- Energy-oriented practices.

- Yoga-based therapeutic practices.

- Acupuncture / Traditional Chinese Medicine knowledge.

- Integrative psychology.

- Other complementary or experiential approaches.



## WHAT I WANT TO LEARN AND EXPERIENCE



Part of my goal is to understand the different approaches available for changing limiting beliefs, transforming emotional patterns, and creating lasting personal change.



I want to understand:



- How do limiting beliefs develop, and how can they be changed?

- How do subconscious patterns influence our thoughts, emotions, and behavior?

- What is the relationship between the nervous system, body, and emotional states?

- How do meditation and visualization influence mental and emotional conditioning?

- How do IFS, somatic work, hypnotherapy, breathwork, and other modalities approach personal transformation differently?

- What happens during each type of session?

- Which techniques are designed to address deeper emotional patterns rather than simply discussing them?



I would like to **experience different techniques through personalized Zoom sessions**, not just learn about them theoretically.



I am interested in someone who can introduce different approaches, explain their purpose, guide appropriate exercises, and help me understand which approaches may be most useful.



## WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



The ideal person could be:



- A Holistic Mind-Body Practitioner.

- A Subconscious Reprogramming Practitioner.

- An IFS / Parts Work Practitioner.

- A Somatic Practitioner.

- A Trauma-Informed Practitioner.

- A Hypnotherapist.

- A Breathwork Practitioner.

- A Meditation Teacher.

- An Integrative Therapist or Counselor.

- A Holistic Life Coach with substantial professional training.

- A Mind-Body Practitioner.

- Someone trained in multiple complementary approaches.



I am particularly interested in someone who has studied **multiple modalities and understands how they can complement one another.**



You should be able to distinguish between techniques you are formally trained or certified in, techniques you have practical experience with, and approaches you simply understand theoretically.



## IMPORTANT – PROFESSIONALISM & OPEN-MINDEDNESS



I value open-mindedness, curiosity, and an interest in personal transformation. However, I also value professionalism, critical thinking, and honesty.



I am not looking for someone who simply repeats spiritual concepts or makes exaggerated claims about healing or transformation.



I want someone who can explain the reasoning behind different approaches, understand their limitations, and work within their professional qualifications and scope of practice.



If you are not a licensed therapist, psychologist, physician, or other licensed healthcare professional, that is okay. Please clearly state your qualifications and professional scope.

Sessions will primarily take place remotely through Zoom.



You should be comfortable:

description:

If you're ready to elevate your career in accounting, we have an exciting opportunity that awaits you!



What We Do

Atomus -- the Latin word for atoms, which are the basic building blocks of the universe. At Atomus Partners, we operate as a back-office nucleus, allowing the organization to focus on what it does best - its core business. We remove the common challenges small and medium-sized businesses often struggle with in developing, growing, and maintaining a highly functional back office (HR, Administrative, Finance/Accounting, IT), and help them to see beyond today.



What You’ll Do

Reporting to our Accounting Manager, our Senior Bookkeeper will independently manage day-to-day accounting operations, take ownership of month-end close activities, and ensure accurate, review-ready financial reporting. Your days will be filled with:



Client and Team Support:

• Independently manage accounting deliverables and collaborate with the Accounting Manager to ensure accurate financial reporting and dependable service. 

• Maintain organized files, ensure deliverables are complete and on time, and support the Accounting Manager in executing key initiatives throughout the year. 

• Work alongside cross-functional partners and external vendors to ensure smooth payroll processing, accurate reporting, and successful year-end preparation. 

• Communicate confidently and professionally with U.S.-based clients, participating in calls, proactively following up on outstanding items, and resolving routine accounting questions. 



Financial Mastery:

• Manage day-to-day activity in QuickBooks Online including transaction coding, accounts payable and receivable workflows, and maintaining clean, organized ledgers. 

• Perform bank and credit card reconciliations, review activity for accuracy, and ensure accounts are supported and properly documented. Independently prepare and post adjusting journal entries such as accruals, prepaids, deferrals, and depreciation. 



Balance Sheet Ownership:

• Own the review and reconciliation of balance sheet accounts to ensure completeness and accuracy. Identify variances or unusual patterns, independently research and resolve discrepancies, and escalate complex issues to the Accounting Manager with proposed solutions. 

• Maintain schedules and take ownership of month-end close processes, ensuring financial statements are accurate, complete, and ready for Accounting Manager review. 



Process Enhancement:

• Bring forward ideas and participate in projects to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and scalability in the accounting function.



What will make you successful in this role (skills)

• Proven Expertise: With at least 5 years of full-cycle US bookkeeping experience, fully utilizing GAAP accounting, you have strong skills in financial reporting, accurate reconciliations, and independently reviewing and analyzing balance sheets and financial statements to identify and resolve discrepancies before final review.

, Ramp, or Melio; experience with Xero is a plus.

When you submit your resume, there will be a question that says “Please include any additional information that you feel has not been previously covered”, please enter your favorite color here.

You are confident in communicating directly with U.S.-based professionals, asking thoughtful questions, and clearly explaining accounting matters.

title: E-Commerce Accountant (CPA)
description:
About the Role

We are a growing, lean US direct-to-consumer (DTC) physical-product brand operating on Shopify with domestic 3PL fulfillment and overseas manufacturing.



We are looking for a Senior E-Commerce Accountant for a two-phase engagement:

1. Phase 1 (3–5 weeks, ~20–30 hrs/week): Build and clean up the last 12 months of books from scratch in QuickBooks Online so our historical financials are accurate, fully reconciled, and accrual-compliant.

2. Phase 2 (Ongoing, ~5–10 hrs/week): Own our monthly close (closed by the 10th business day of each month), maintain clean Balance Sheet tie-outs, and run a monthly variance check comparing our internal analytics dashboards against our closed P&L.



Our long-term goal is clean, exit-ready financials without bloated software overhead. We are not looking for a general VA or bank-feed categorizer—we need a sharp accountant who can architect a proper US DTC setup independently and keep Balance Sheets spotless.



What You’ll Own

1. Phase 1: 12-Month Historical Rebuild



- Chart of Accounts Design: Structure a clean, exit-ready US DTC Chart of Accounts in QuickBooks Online from scratch (proper separation of Gross Sales, Contra-Revenue, Landed COGS, Marketing, OpEx, and clearly segregated one
 add-backs). Our US CPA will review your proposed structure before final posting.



- Shopify & Gateway Reconciliation: Accurately record gross sales, discounts, refunds, chargebacks, merchant fees, and sales tax payable across Shopify Payments and connected gateways. A2X, Link My Books, or Synder are optional—we prefer keeping our tech stack lean with manual monthly summary journal entries if you can execute month-end cutoffs cleanly, though we are open to a summary connector if you can make the case that it saves more in hours than it costs.



- Accrual Inventory & Landed COGS: Rebuild the past 12 months of inventory and COGS in a clean Google Sheet/Excel roll-forward and post monthly summary entries into QBO—tracking supplier wires as Prepaid Inventory, received 3PL stock as Inventory Asset, and allocating inbound freight, duties, and tariffs into per-unit COGS as orders ship.



- Full Balance Sheet Reconciliations: Tie out every bank account, credit card, payment clearing account, inventory balance, and loan to third-party statements for all 12 months.



2. Phase 2: Ongoing Monthly Close & Dashboard Audit



- Deliver a closed P&L, Balance Sheet, Statement of Cash Flows, and full Balance Sheet reconciliations by the 10th business day of every month.



- Update the monthly landed COGS and 3PL inventory schedule (accounting for units sold, damaged inventory, and free warranty/replacement shipments).



- Maintain a 1-page Monthly Dashboard vs. P&L Variance Bridge in Google Sheets that reconciles our analytics dashboard’s reported net profit against QuickBooks net income—pinpointing gaps from refund timing lags, blended processing fees, fulfillment overages, and unmapped OpEx.



- Provide a brief written close summary calling out margin shifts, anomalies, or cash flow items to watch.



Proactivity & Chasing Down Information (Critical)



Because we are rebuilding 12 months of history while running a lean operation, every invoice, wire detail, and shipment breakdown won't always be sitting neatly in one folder. We need an owner, not a passive ticket-taker.

Don't guess and don't stall: Never silently leave items in Uncategorized Expense or wait around for someone to notice a missing document.



Go get the answers: You have full green light—and are expected—to proactively track down what you need. That means messaging our sourcing agent for missing commercial invoices, packing lists, or freight/duty breakdowns, pulling inventory or fee reports from our 3PL, and following up with vendors when receipts are missing.



Ask me directly (and cleanly): If you see a credit card charge, wire, or expense you don't recognize, ask me what it is. Ideal habit: keep a running "Questions for Founder" tab in Google Sheets and batch your questions 1–2 times a week so we can clear them fast.



Must-Have Qualifications

- Philippine CPA license strongly preferred (or an equivalent senior US e-commerce accounting track record).

- 3+ years of US DTC / Shopify accrual accounting experience, including at least two completed 6-to-12-month historical cleanup/rebuild projects.

- Expert in QuickBooks Online and comfortable doing manual monthly Shopify summary journal entries and clearing-account cutoffs (experience with A2X, Link My Books, or Synder is a plus, not required).

- Proven experience building landed COGS trackers and inventory roll-forwards in Google Sheets or Excel (SUMIFS, XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, zero hardcoded summary cells).

- Prior experience at a US-facing accounting BPO (e.g., TOA Global, Cloudstaff) or Big 4 audit firm is a strong plus.



How to Apply (Required)

- Give a brief overview of your history with working with DTC ecommerce clients, the platforms you used, etc.

- Supply your resume

- Optional bonus: If you already happen to have an anonymized/dummy-data P&L layout or COGS sheet handy, feel free to share a link—not required if your past work is under NDA.

title: Virtual Production Coordinator – Construction Estimating, Takeoffs & Production Planning
description:
A growing outdoor-living construction company is looking for an experienced, full-time Virtual Production Coordinator who understands construction, estimating, material takeoffs, subcontractor scopes, and production planning.



This is not a generic VA or administrative position. We need someone who can look at a sold construction project, understand how it will be built, identify the trades required, determine the materials and labor needed, and prepare the job for production.



You will take a top-down approach to managing our production pipeline by looking ahead at our calendar, identifying upcoming sold jobs, and ensuring they are properly prepared before their scheduled start dates.



Pay / Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week, paid weekly.



Note: All applicants must include a short introduction video (60 seconds to 2 minutes). Read the instructions below.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Review sold projects, plans, drawings, measurements, and scopes of work to understand what needs to be built.

- Identify the trades and subcontractors required for each job and understand the sequence of construction.

- Perform material takeoffs and calculate quantities needed for each project.

- Identify labor requirements and prepare subcontractor scopes and work orders.

- Prepare material lists, purchase orders, and coordinate material ordering.

- Look ahead at our production calendar, identify upcoming sold jobs, and proactively prepare them for production.

- Manage multiple projects at once, tracking materials, subcontractors, permits, and outstanding items to ensure jobs are ready to start.

- Identify potential delays, missing information, and production issues before they become problems.

- Assisting Project Manager in the Field.



STRONG FIT

- Experience in construction estimating, material takeoffs, or production coordination.

- Strong understanding of residential construction, remodeling, outdoor living, decks, patios, pergolas, or hardscaping.

- Ability to read construction plans and drawings and calculate material quantities.

- Ability to identify trades, labor requirements, and construction phases.

- Experience preparing work orders, material lists, and purchase orders.

- Highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple projects independently.



ROLE BOUNDARY

- The Project Manager handles field execution and construction decisions. The Production Coordinator is responsible for understanding each job, preparing labor and material takeoffs, coordinating trades and materials, and ensuring projects are ready for production.

- We need someone who can look ahead, take ownership, and keep our production pipeline moving without waiting for direction.



TO APPLY

Put READY in the first line of your application.



Then answer:

- What construction, estimating, material takeoff, purchasing, or project coordination experience do you have?

- Have you performed material takeoffs from construction plans or drawings? Explain what types of projects and materials.

- Can you identify the trades required for a construction project and determine the labor and materials needed? Provide an example.

- What experience do you have preparing work orders, subcontractor scopes, material lists, or purchase orders?

- How would you manage a calendar of sold construction jobs to ensure upcoming projects are properly prepared and ready to start?

- What construction software, estimating tools, or project management platforms have you used?

- Are you comfortable working around US EST hours, and what is your earliest start date?

- Required Introduction Video (60 seconds to 2 minutes):

- Record a short video introducing yourself, explaining your construction experience, and why you believe you are a strong fit for this position.

- Include a viewable link (Loom, Google Drive, etc.) in your application. Make sure the link does not require access approval. 



APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VIDEO WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.

title: Phone Sales (Inbound & Outbound) | Remote | Base + Commission
description:
Full-Time | Work From Home | US-Based Luxury Day Spa

Compensation: Negotiable Base Pay + Sales Commissions + Performance Bonuses

Schedule: Wednesday–Sunday, 10 AM–7 PM US Eastern Time (EST/EDT). Fixed schedule.

Location: Remote



Are You a Natural Sales Closer?



Do you enjoy talking to customers, turning inquiries into actual sales, and earning more when you perform well?



We're looking for an experienced Phone Sales Closer who can confidently convert incoming inquiries into paid bookings, follow up with potential clients, reactivate previous customers, and help grow a luxury spa business.



This is more than an appointment-setting or customer service position. You'll take ownership of sales opportunities from the first conversation through the final booking.



If you love sales, know how to handle objections, and have a track record of achieving revenue targets, we want to hear from you.



About Us

Majesty Day Spa is an established luxury spa in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, offering massages, premium facials, couples experiences, spa packages, memberships, and group celebrations.



We're expanding our sales efforts and looking for someone who can help us increase bookings, build lasting customer relationships, and identify new revenue opportunities.



What You'll Be Doing

Phone Sales & Booking Conversion

- Answer incoming calls and convert inquiries into paid spa bookings.

- Confidently present packages, pricing, and available services.

- Recommend upgrades, add-ons, memberships, and premium experiences.

- Handle objections and guide customers toward a purchase.



Outbound Sales & Customer Reactivation

- Follow up with leads who haven't completed their bookings.

- Reconnect with previous customers and encourage repeat visits.

- Reach out to prospective customers about relevant packages and promotions.

- Build relationships that generate repeat business.



Group Sales & Revenue Growth

- Convert inquiries for couples packages, birthdays, group events, and special occasions.

- Identify opportunities for larger bookings and higher-value purchases.

- Track sales opportunities, follow-ups, conversion rates, and revenue results.

- Recommend practical ways to increase bookings and customer spending.



Who We're Looking For

- Proven experience in phone sales, including closing deals.

- Experience with inbound and outbound sales calls.

- Excellent spoken English and a confident, professional phone presence.

- Strong persuasion, objection-handling, and negotiation skills.

- Comfortable using a CRM, booking platform, or sales tracker.

- Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working toward sales targets.

- Available to work the exact Wednesday–Sunday US Eastern schedule.



A Plus, But Not Required:

Experience in beauty, spas, wellness, hospitality, fitness, real estate, or other appointment-based service industries.

We're open to experienced BPO sales agents, inside sales representatives, and sales closers from other industries who can demonstrate strong results.



Compensation & Career Growth

- We believe strong sales performance should be rewarded.

- Negotiable base compensation based on your skills and experience.

- Additional sales commissions.

- Performance-based bonuses.

- Opportunities for compensation increases based on measurable results.

- Long-term career advancement, with potential to grow into a Sales & Revenue Growth Manager or Director role.



Projected Total Earning Potential: $10–$26+/hour, depending on individual sales performance.



This is a projected combined earning range including base compensation, commissions, and bonuses—not guaranteed hourly pay.



We value consistent results and want someone who is motivated to grow both the business and their own earning potential.



How to Apply

Please send us:

- Your resume highlighting relevant sales experience.

- Your expected base hourly rate in USD.

- A 60-second voice introduction explaining your previous phone sales experience and why you believe you're a strong closer.

- One sales achievement you're proud of, such as hitting a quota, increasing conversions, or closing a difficult sale.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview and a practical sales role-play.



If you can confidently turn conversations into paying customers, we'd like to hear from you.

title: AI & Business Growth Specialist
description:
Job Title: AI & Business Growth Specialist

Location: Remote

Job Type: Task-Based | Gig Work | Project-Based

Starting Rate: $5.00/hour equivalent or agreed project-based rate, depending on assignment



Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled, systems-oriented professional with expertise in AI, automation, APIs, GoHighLevel (GHL), social media management, digital marketing, online marketplaces, and e-commerce operations.

This is a task-based gig opportunity for an independent professional who can deliver specific projects, assignments, and business solutions on an as-needed basis. Rather than following a fixed work schedule or traditional employment arrangement, the engagement will focus on clearly defined tasks, project requirements, deadlines, and measurable deliverables.

The selected professional will support the development and optimization of technology, marketing, and operational systems across our growing digital business ecosystem. Assignments may include building AI-powered workflows, implementing automation, managing social media projects, optimizing CRM systems, and supporting e-commerce operations.

We are looking for someone who can work independently, solve technical and operational problems, and consistently deliver quality outputs within agreed timelines.



Key Responsibilities

AI, Automation & Systems Development

Design, build, and implement AI-powered workflows that improve operational efficiency across multiple businesses.

Develop scalable business systems that integrate marketing, sales, customer service, operations, and internal processes.

Create and maintain automation workflows using AI platforms, APIs, webhooks, Zapier, Make.com, GoHighLevel, and other integration tools.

Build and optimize CRM systems in GoHighLevel, including:

Pipelines

Automations

Lead nurturing

Sales funnels

Forms

Calendars

Customer journeys

Integrate CRMs, e-commerce platforms, marketplaces, payment systems, communication tools, and other SaaS applications into a unified ecosystem.

Design scalable system architecture that supports business expansion and operational efficiency.

Analyze workflows to identify bottlenecks and replace manual processes with automation wherever possible.

Troubleshoot automation issues and continuously improve system reliability, security, and performance.

Maintain documentation, workflow diagrams, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all systems and automations.

Research, test, and implement emerging AI technologies that improve productivity, customer experience, and operational performance.



Social Media Management & Digital Marketing

Manage multiple social media accounts across different brands while maintaining consistent branding and messaging.

Develop and execute social media strategies that support business growth, customer engagement, and lead generation.

Create, edit, schedule, and publish high-quality content using AI-assisted content creation tools.

Design and maintain monthly content calendars aligned with marketing campaigns and promotional initiatives.

Monitor engagement, audience growth, reach, and campaign performance across all platforms.

Analyze social media analytics and provide actionable recommendations to improve visibility, conversions, and ROI.

Respond to comments, messages, and customer inquiries when required while maintaining a professional brand voice.

Repurpose content across multiple platforms to maximize reach and efficiency.

Automate content scheduling, publishing, customer engagement, lead capture, and follow-up sequences using GoHighLevel and other automation platforms.

Stay current on platform updates, social media trends, AI marketing tools, and emerging digital marketing strategies.



E-Commerce & Marketplace Operations

Support the development, optimization, and management of e-commerce stores and marketplace operations.

Assist with product listings, inventory workflows, promotional campaigns, and customer experience improvements.

Build systems that streamline marketplace operations and improve operational efficiency.

Integrate marketplace platforms with CRM, automation, inventory, and marketing systems.

Identify opportunities to improve conversion rates, customer acquisition, and operational scalability through automation and AI.



Business Strategy & Process Improvement

Collaborate with leadership to translate business objectives into scalable technology and marketing solutions.

Recommend AI, automation, and digital marketing strategies that improve productivity and revenue.

Ensure accurate data synchronization and seamless information flow across all connected platforms.

Develop systems that improve customer acquisition, marketing performance, sales processes, reporting, and business intelligence.

Continuously identify opportunities to optimize workflows, reduce operational costs, and improve overall business performance.



Qualifications Required

Strong knowledge of AI tools and practical AI implementation.

Experience with automation platforms such as Zapier, Make.com, GoHighLevel, or similar.

Experience working with APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations.

Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL).

Experience managing business social media accounts and digital marketing campaigns.

Understanding of major social media platforms, analytics, scheduling tools, and content strategies.

Experience supporting e-commerce businesses or online marketplaces.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and systems-thinking abilities.

Excellent organizational and time management skills.

Ability to work independently while meeting deadlines.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.



Preferred

Experience designing end-to-end business automation systems.

Background in AI implementation or systems architecture.

Experience integrating multiple SaaS platforms.

Familiarity with Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon, Walmart Marketplace, Etsy, or similar platforms.

Experience with prompt engineering and AI-assisted content creation.

Experience creating dashboards, reporting systems, and business analytics.

Understanding of SEO, paid advertising, and digital marketing automation is a plus.

Engagement Structure & Work Arrangement

This opportunity follows a task-based gig-work arrangement, not a traditional full-time or part-time employment structure.

Assignments will be provided based on current business requirements and project priorities.

Each assignment will have a defined scope, expected deliverables, and agreed completion timeline.

Work will be compensated based on the agreed hourly equivalent, task rate, or project rate.

There is no guaranteed minimum number of working hours or assignments.

The professional may accept assignments based on availability and capacity.

Work schedules will be flexible, provided that agreed deadlines and deliverables are met.

Additional assignments may be offered based on performance, business needs, and the quality of completed work.

Long-term collaboration may be considered based on consistent performance and ongoing project requirements.



Hiring Process

Our selection process prioritizes demonstrated technical competency and practical execution.

The process includes:

Application review.

Initial interview or technical assessment, if necessary.

Paid production-based trial assignment involving actual GoHighLevel-related business requirements.

Evaluation based on:

Technical proficiency and platform knowledge.

Accuracy and functionality of configured workflows.

Quality of automation and system integrations.

Problem-solving and troubleshooting capabilities.

Attention to detail.

Timeliness and adherence to agreed deadlines.

Documentation and communication.

Ability to work independently.

Approval for potential ongoing gig assignments.

Trial assignments may involve configuring workflows, building funnels, setting up integrations, troubleshooting existing automations, or developing other relevant GoHighLevel solutions.

The scope and compensation for the trial assignment will be agreed upon before work begins. Successful completion may lead to additional projects and recurring assignments.



What You Can Expect

Starting Rate: $5.00/hour equivalent or an agreed project-based rate, depending on assignment scope and complexity.

Performance Review: Evaluation after 90 days of collaboration, where applicable.

Compensation Growth: Opportunity for rate adjustments based on technical proficiency, quality of work, reliability, and measurable contributions.

Flexible Engagement: No fixed daily working hours or mandatory work schedule.

Output-Based Compensation: Payment based on agreed tasks, completed deliverables, or approved project milestones.

Recurring Opportunities: Potential for regular CRM maintenance, automation development, and marketing optimization assignments.

Multi-Business Exposure: Opportunities to work on GoHighLevel systems and automation projects across multiple businesses.

Technical Development: Exposure to CRM architecture, marketing automation, API integrations, AI-powered workflows, and e-commerce systems.

Independent Work Environment: Flexibility to manage your approach and working schedule while meeting agreed deadlines and project requirements.

Performance-Based Growth: Opportunities to handle more complex technical projects and higher-value assignments as your expertise develops.



About the Company

We are building a multi-business digital ecosystem powered by AI, automation, scalable operational systems, digital marketing, and intelligent business processes. Our mission is to create an integrated infrastructure that connects multiple companies through automation, technology, and revenue-driven execution.

We value professionals who are proactive, systems-oriented, resourceful, execution-focused, and committed to building long-term solutions that create measurable business impact.

We are seeking a reliable, detail-oriented professional with hands-on experience in US tax preparation, bookkeeping, and financial reporting.

This is a task-based gig opportunity for an independent professional who can complete specific tax preparation, bookkeeping, and accounting assignments based on business requirements. Rather than following a traditional full-time work schedule, the engagement will focus on assigned tasks, clearly defined deliverables, accuracy, and agreed completion deadlines. The selected professional will support our accounting and tax operations by preparing individual, business, nonprofit, and state tax returns, maintaining accurate financial records, and ensuring that clients' books remain organized, compliant, and tax-ready.



This opportunity is ideal for someone who can work independently, manage multiple assignments, maintain high-quality standards, and consistently deliver accurate work within agreed timelines.



Job Details

As a US Tax Preparer & Bookkeeper, you will manage tax preparation and bookkeeping responsibilities for multiple clients, maintain organized documentation, and support efficient accounting workflows. Your work will play a key role in ensuring compliance, financial accuracy, and a seamless tax preparation process for our clients.

You will initially undergo a partial onboarding and testing phase designed to evaluate your technical skills, accuracy, quality of work, efficiency, and ability to meet established performance expectations.

The testing phase may include practical assignments involving actual tax and bookkeeping scenarios. The workload will be based on assigned tasks and business needs and will not necessarily require a full five-day workload.



What You'll Be Doing

Tax Preparation & Compliance

Prepare Individual Tax Returns (Form 1040) and related schedules.

Prepare Business Tax Returns, including Forms 1120, 1120S, and 1065.

Prepare Sole Proprietorship, Partnership, LLC, S Corporation, and C Corporation tax returns.
